reviews.title: Couldn't have done it without you both
reviews.author: Louise O'Neill, Children in Wales
reviews.quote: Had a great experience, from start to finish, working with Gemma and Sarah on the implementation of our Beacon CRM. Nothing was too much trouble and they were super very friendly and approachable. Would highly recommend! Thank you both.

reviews.title: Fab support
reviews.author: Kelly Mason, Children in Wales
reviews.quote: Fabulous people and a great help for what would have been a huge job for our small organisation. They were there to answer any questions and help with solutions for being able to import the right data for the reports we needed. Thank you for everything

reviews.title: Great support from Gemma and Noah
reviews.author: Ellie Adams, ORCA
reviews.quote: Excellent support from Gemma and Noah when transitioning our volunteer management system to Beacon. The new system is clear, efficient and user‑friendly, helping us better support 700 volunteer Marine Mammal Surveyors. They calmly solved every issue and went above and beyond. A pleasure to work with and highly recommended.

reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.author: Natalie Norris
reviews.quote: Gemma has been incredible throughout are implementation of Beacon and helping with training and tweaking the system so it works perfectly for us. We had a tight time frame which Gemma worked to, not only guiding us but also providing tools so we could do some of the work ourselves and making sure we completed it in time. Gemma took the time to know our needs and thought about how we would use the CRM in practice, then tailoring the CRM for us! A huge thank you to Gemma - highly recommend!

reviews.title: Complex CRM implementation delivered on time
reviews.author: Davina Allen, Marches Energy Agency
reviews.quote: Gemma and the team were fantastic throughout the process of delivering a complex CRM on a tight time frame. They were friendly and approachable through out and helped us work through some logistical challenges. The training was clear and well received by our staff. Make IT a Plan with Beacon were ideal partners for our project. Many thanks again all!

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.author: Lucy Burton, Naval Families Federation
reviews.quote: Gemma and Noah were very helpful in ensuring our transition to Beacon went very smoothly. Crucially, they didn't just do everything we asked - they provided suggestions for how we could better use the system to meet the needs of our charity, and helped make sure we fully understood all of the functionality of Beacon. Would definitely recommend using them!
